description.value: Tofitian is a cafe and bakery that has been a community institution in Tofino for over 20 years, nestled in the rainforest along the Pacific Rim Highway at the edge of the continent. Fresh baked goods roll out at 7am daily — from breakfast polenta and croissants to savoury turnovers and vegan brownies — making it a natural first stop before a day on the wild coast. The cafe also runs an online store shipping west coast goods province-wide, and its branded merchandise doubles as a local souvenir.

address.value: 1180 Pacific Rim Hwy, Tofino, British Columbia V0R 2Z0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the cafe is open and operating at 1180 Pacific Rim Hwy, Tofino. The site explicitly states vegan, gluten-free, keto, and vegetarian options are available daily, overriding OSM's diet:gluten_free=no tag. A phone number discrepancy exists between website pages (725-3621 on the main/Find Us section vs. 725-2631 on the contact page), and no bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Phone number discrepancy within the website: main page 'Find Us' section lists (250) 725-3621 while the /contact-us page lists 250.725.2631 — digits differ (3621 vs 2631). The main-page number has been used; recommend verifying.
OSM tag diet:gluten_free=no contradicts website, which explicitly states gluten-free options are available every day. Website preferred per instructions.
OSM name is 'Tofitian' but the business refers to itself as 'Tofitian Cafe' or 'Tofitian Cafe & Bakery' on its website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, long-established cafe confirmed open with active website, full menu, and known physical address in Tofino. A useful stop for touring cyclists on the Pacific Rim.
